package.description: Annotates, reviews, and measures sound events in audio data.

en-US.description: Annotates, reviews, and measures sound events in audio data.
en-US.longDescription: Raven Annotate is a free tool for annotation, review, measurement, and analysis of audio data. It is designed to replace work previously done in Raven Pro and supports rapid sound-event annotation and review.
en-US.name: Raven Annotate
